name: lib/codec
description: Defines explicit, reusable conversions between a value and text.
readme: Defines explicit, reusable conversions between a value and text.
Import this module with use codec.

files.content:
-- Defines explicit, reusable conversions between a value and text.
public define Codec[T] as record {
  encode of type function taking (T) giving failable text.
  decode of type function taking (text) giving failable T.
}.
public use "codec" function encode[T](value T) giving failable text.
public use "codec" function decode[T](source text) giving failable T.
